letter_date.description: The date the letter was written, as printed

address.description: The employer's address, as one line

phone.description: The contact phone number given for verification

email.description: The contact email address given for verification

employee.description: The employee and the terms of their employment

employment_start.description: When employment began, as printed, e.g. a year or a date

currently_employed.description: True if the letter says the employee is currently employed

pay_minimum.description: The lower end of the stated pay, in dollars, or the pay if a single figure is given

pay_maximum.description: The upper end of the stated pay, in dollars, or null if a single figure is given

pay_period.description: The period the pay covers, e.g. 'weekly', 'hourly', 'annual'

in_good_standing.description: True if the letter states the employee is in good standing
